
## Figures

::::{.columns}

:::{.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-world
#| fig-cap: Countries first letter F (unresponsive)

p <- ne_countries(scale="small") |>
  mutate(f = ifelse(substring(sovereignt, 1,1) == "M", TRUE, FALSE)) |>
  ggplot(aes(fill = f, text = sovereignt)) +
    geom_sf(col = "grey30") +
    coord_sf(expand = FALSE) +
    scale_fill_discrete(
        name = "Wahlsystemtyp",
        na.translate = FALSE
    )

gu_map(p)
```

:::

:::{.column width="50%"}

```{r}
#| label: fig-plotly
#| fig-cap: Responsive plotly figure

ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text", width = 525, height = 310)
```

:::

::::
